profile.name: Samia Sharmin
profile.title_line: Architect | Writer | Content & Brand Strategist | Heritage Researcher | Educator

homepage_intro.short: Architect, writer, researcher, and design communicator working across architectural storytelling, heritage documentation, material narratives, editorial writing, and built-environment communication.
homepage_intro.long:
Hi, I am Samia Sharmin.

I am an architect, writer, content strategist, educator, and heritage researcher working across building-material brand communication, architecture-focused editorial practice, publication coordination, research documentation, exhibition and gallery support, youth engagement, and design communication.

My work translates architectural, material, cultural, and institutional knowledge into clear public-facing content for both specialist and general audiences. Through editorial workflows, interviews, visual coordination, campaign brief development, academic teaching, archival documentation, heritage programming, and stakeholder collaboration, I try to make built-environment stories more accessible, meaningful, and carefully communicated.
